rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Production-grade Firecrawl integration built with strict TypeScript ES2024, Effect-TS, and the Bun runtime. Provides comprehensive tool coverage including scraping, mapping, searching, crawling, extraction, AI agents, and browser automation through Firecrawl's API. Features typed configuration via Effect Config, structured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics, request timeouts, and both single-tenant and multi-tenant cloud service modes with per-request authentication. Deployable to Vercel serverless or as a local Bun dev server with safe mode restrictions for security-sensitive environments.
